title: Neutrino Domain Observation Set
description: The DETERMINISTIC middle stage of domain-dataset extraction: source-agnostic FACTS a corpus extractor (Solidity, SWIFT/Prowide, future FHIR) reads out of a governed corpus, sitting between neutrino.domain-corpus-manifest (governed input) and neutrino.domain-vocabulary-proposal (AI-assisted candidates). Every observation is a fact bound to a corpus construct via required provenance and drawn from a controlled per-dimension vocabulary; the set is bound to the exact corpus content via corpusRef.contentHash. Because observations are deterministic facts, this stage MUST NOT carry AI-trust metadata — no confidence, reviewStatus, model, prompt, temperature, or citations (that metadata belongs to the later neutrino.domain-vocabulary-proposal stage). extractor is a deterministic tool+version identity, not a model identity. Fail-closed (additionalProperties:false everywhere). Validated by scripts/corpus/validate_domain_observation_set.py, which mirrors this schema AND enforces the cross-references JSON Schema cannot express (observation dimension is declared, observation value is in that dimension's vocabulary, observation id uniqueness, corpus content-hash binding, span ordering) and rejects AI-trust fields with a trust-boundary-specific diagnostic. See docs/domains/DOMAIN_DATASET_EXTRACTION.md.

contentHash.description: sha256:<64 hex> — the same content-hash shape used by neutrino.domain-corpus-manifest sources.

provenance.description: Where in the corpus this fact was observed. REQUIRED on every observation — an observation with no source construct is not a fact and is rejected.

source.description: A corpus source id or path, as declared in the domain-corpus-manifest (e.g. a .sol file).

construct.description: The named construct the fact was read from (e.g. a contract, function, or type name).

constructKind.description: Optional kind of the construct (e.g. contract, function, modifier) — source-agnostic, so a free string, not an enum.

span.description: Optional 1-based source span for traceability. startLine must be <= endLine (enforced by the validator).

observation.description: One deterministic fact: a corpus construct exhibits value V along controlled dimension D. No AI-trust fields (confidence/reviewStatus/model/prompt/citations) — those belong to the later vocabulary-proposal stage.

id.description: Stable within-set observation id; unique across observations (uniqueness enforced by the validator).

dimension.description: The dimension this fact is about; MUST be a declared key of the top-level `dimensions` block (enforced by the validator).

value.description: The observed value; MUST be a member of `dimensions[dimension]`'s controlled vocabulary (enforced by the validator).

note.description: Optional human-readable note on the fact. NOT a confidence signal — this stage carries no AI-trust metadata.

corpusRef.description: Binds this observation set to the EXACT corpus content it was extracted from. corpusId identifies the domain-corpus-manifest; contentHash pins the content so a re-extraction over changed corpus content produces a set that no longer matches the recorded binding.

corpusId.description: corpusId of the neutrino.domain-corpus-manifest the facts were drawn from.

extractor.description: Deterministic tool identity that produced this set. Tool + version ONLY — NOT a model/prompt identity. A given (tool, version) over the same pinned corpus content must produce the same observations.

version.description: Extractor tool version (deterministic identity — e.g. a semver or pinned build id).

dimensions.description: The controlled vocabulary per dimension, generalizing the fixed `dimensions` block of neutrino-solidity-samples/classification.json to a source-agnostic open map: each key is a dimension name, each value the allowed vocabulary for that dimension. Every observation's (dimension, value) is checked against this block by the validator.
